title: Deterministic financial-model builds and deployed evals
points: Added a deterministic model-build computation stage for explicit financial-model requests: banks use a bank template, non-financial operating companies use a corporate template, and holding companies fail loudly until NAV and investment-portfolio inputs are modeled.

Model builds now emit actuals, assumptions, and five-year forecast tables, save snapshots in the user's Durable Object workspace, and support follow-up assumption updates such as changing KOHC revenue growth to 8%.
Added an EVAL_TOKEN-protected deployed eval runner that writes JSON and HTML trace reports and verifies bank, non-financial, saved-model update, and unsupported holding-company paths.
